_doc: v3 settings for the ordnancetruck (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from ordnancetruck_prep.json (work dir ordnancetruck_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/ordnancetruck_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: ordnancetruck

source.title: Utility Truck
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 3, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in ordnancetruck_veh.json). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (ordnancetruck_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_l0`..) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no collapse on the shell-soup Hunter route; these hulls are clean). WHEELED, 2 axles (the original has 4 and two red cargo containers; the kit is a plain utility truck with a flat bed). The front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`. No turret or gun.
